name: Sweden
description: Sweden from the Vikings to the Kalmar Union, Gustav Vasa, a great power of the Baltic, neutrality, the Nobel Prize and the welfare state.

checkpoints.name: Vikings and kings
checkpoints.note: Swedish Vikings sailed east down the rivers of Russia. Christian kings united the land, and it joined Denmark and Norway in the Kalmar Union in 1397.

checkpoints.name: A great power
checkpoints.note: Gustav Vasa broke from the union in 1523. Under Gustavus Adolphus Sweden became a great power of the Baltic, until defeat by Russia in the Great Northern War. Linnaeus named the living world.

checkpoints.name: Neutral Sweden
checkpoints.note: Sweden lost Finland in 1809 and has not fought a war since 1814. Nobel's prizes were first given in 1901, and the country stayed neutral through both world wars.

checkpoints.name: The welfare state
checkpoints.note: Sweden built a generous welfare state. ABBA, IKEA and Spotify spread round the world, and in 2024 Sweden joined NATO.
